# Q-051 E7: a book started part-way through its life, the 3,000.00 USD its
# savings account already held entered as an opening balance against equity,
# valued at what those dollars cost, 4,050.00 CAD. Onto
# a_usd_invoice_and_bill_for_statement_lines_on_a_holding_account.txt.
#
# The value is what says what the dollars cost, so the opening balance opens a
# cost basis of 3,000.00 USD at 1.35, and whatever later spends them gives it,
# as a spend of dollars bought would. A book need not be imported from the
# day its currency arrived.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_statement_line_on_a_holding_account_is_edited_into_what_it_settles.py.
